findings.description: The KMS key does not enable automatic key rotation (enable_key_rotation is absent, defaulting to false), so the same key material encrypts audit bucket data indefinitely and a compromised key cannot be retired through rotation.

No key policy is defined, so KMS applies the default policy granting the AWS account root full administrative control (kms:*, including PutKeyPolicy) over this audit key. Combined with account-level principals, this permits unrestricted re-keying/deletion and privilege escalation rather than least-privilege access to the audit data.

deletion_window_in_days = 7 is the minimum and gives the shortest possible window before this audit-trail key is destroyed; accidental or malicious scheduling of deletion can render audit log data unrecoverable with minimal opportunity to detect and cancel it.
